title: Why you solve equations backwards: socks and shoes

lines.say: Three x plus five equals twenty.

lines.text: {offline} To take them off, {shoesoff} *shoes* come off {first} *first.*
{recipe0} This equation is a {recipe} *recipe* done to {x} $x$.
lines.say: This equation is a recipe done to x.
Times three, then plus five: twenty.
Minus five: fifteen. Divide by three: five.

lines.text: {last} Plus 5 went on *last,* so it comes off {first2} *first.*
lines.say: Plus five went on last, so it comes off first.
